description: Remove from Liked Songs any tracks that also appear in a given playlist. Quota: 2 GETs + DELETE (chunked). PREVIEWS BY DEFAULT — pass dry_run=false to commit. Removing 10+ saved tracks additionally requires elicitation confirmation (or SPOTIFY_MCP_CONFIRM=never for automation).

dry_run.description: Preview only: perform the read side and return a PLAN without changing anything. Default true — pass dry_run=false to commit.

playlist_id.description: Playlist ID whose tracks will be removed from library

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: remove_from_library_by_playlist
